text:
anya: Quick sync — private/VPC customers keep asking for per-tenant egress consent + explicit fallback guarantees. We need an API + console surface. Do we have a proposed contract?
samir: I sketched something. Minimal fields on tenant: `egress_allowed_regions` (list), `egress_consent` (bool), `fallback_strategy` (enum).
jules: Important: on‑prem tenants often forbid any external egress, so default for VPC should be `no_fallback`. We must fail closed, not silently route to other regions.
kevin: Agreed. Also we need a telemetry signal when fallback happens with a reason code so SRE/CS can triage. Customers will ask "why did you serve X instead of Y".
maria: Console UX: show a badge on the tenant page when any fallback events happened in last 24h and a small timeline with links to the request traces. Allow customers to opt into cross-region fallback for short windows.
samir: Edge case: primary regional pool is overloaded but allowed regions list excludes viable fallbacks. Proposal: add `degraded_response` fallback type that returns prefix-only cached tokens or a 503-with-graceful-message if tenant forbids egress.
anya: Proposal for `fallback_strategy` enum values: `no_fallback`, `regional_variant`, `degraded_response`, `cross_region_if_consented`. Defaults: hosted tenants -> `regional_variant`, VPC/private -> `no_fallback`.
jules: API contract details: add to `GET /v1/tenants` response and `PATCH /v1/tenants/{id}` accept the fields. Also add `route.policy` flag for per-route overrides. PR stub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1234 (WIP).
kevin: Telemetry shape suggestion: event `routing.fallback` with tags: `tenant_id`, `requested_model`, `served_model`, `reason`, `latency_ms`, `cost_delta`, `egress_regions_attempted`. Example: 
```
{
  "event": "routing.fallback",
  "tenant_id": "t-842",
  "requested_model": "gptx-16k",
  "served_model": "gptx-8k-quant",
  "reason": "capacity_constraint",
  "latency_ms": "120",
  "cost_delta": "-0.0023"
}
```
maria: Cost implications: when fallback serves a cheaper quantized variant we should record the effective unit price and show it in billing UI with a line item "fallback adjustments". Also quota semantics need clarity — does fallback consume the same quota? I think yes but mark it.
samir: For VPC/onprem, control plane cannot initiate egress to disallowed regions. We must enforce at routing layer preflight: `if not intersection(egress_allowed_regions, candidate_region) -> skip`. No implicit overrides.
anya: UX for rollouts: when enabling `cross_region_if_consented` add a modal that warns about data egress and shows telemetry retention and KMS/HSM notes. Store consent audit log.
jules: Implementation items: console mock update, API schema, backend route filter, policy evaluator, telemetry event, billing mapping.
kevin: I'll add the telemetry event and a quick doc in /docs/telemetry/routing.md. Maria, can you stub the billing change?
maria: Yep, will add billing PR and example invoices.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout for feature/egress-controls -> staging started @here
samir: Action items/owners: Samir -> draft API schema PR; Jules -> console mocks + modal copy; Kevin -> telemetry + event; Maria -> billing + quota doc; Anya -> review policy evaluator design. Target: EOW for staging canary.
anya: :thumbsup: thanks team — let's catch up tomorrow during 10am sync if any blockers.
